Joint experimental beam has the same hard support filter and charges lookups separately. Probability normalization remains over all learned tags, not renormalized by support. Unknown role/intent combinations cannot be predicted by this closed training-support schema; absence of a role is not semantic proof. Single surviving local tag has unavailable margin, not calibrated confidence.
